## Contributor Checklist
Before submitting this pull request, please verify:
- [ ] **Zero PII**: No personal usernames, account IDs, internal hostnames, or private IP addresses are present.
- [ ] **Vendor Neutrality**: No proprietary vendor names, reverse-engineered internal trademarks, or sensitive internals are referenced. Focus strictly on public, solution-oriented Linux desktop APIs and protocols.
- [ ] **Non-Root / Safe Execution**: All code runs strictly in unprivileged user space (`systemd --user`, `~/.local/`, etc.). No `sudo` or elevated privileges required.
- [ ] **Tested on JioPC**: Changes have been tested and verified to work on JioPC (or standard XRDP desktop sessions).
